title.en: An Act Transferring the Seat of Government of the Municipality of San Pablo, Province of Isabela, to the Site in the Old Poblacion Commonly Known as Centro

text.en: The seat of government of the Municipality of San Pablo, Province of Isabela, is transferred to the site in the old poblacion commonly known as Centro in the same municipality.
Republic Act Numbered Eleven hundred seventy-seven is hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 5, 1959.
